name: Basic Dosage Calculator
description: Calculates the basic amount of medication to administer using the standard formula: (Desired / Have) x Quantity.

formulas.label: Amount to Administer
formulas.explanation: Calculates the required volume or number of tablets to give to the patient.

sections.title: Clinical Safety Reminders
sections.content: Accurate medication calculation is critical for patient safety. The 'Desired over Have' formula is a standard method for basic dose determination.
bullets: Ensure units of measurement for both Desired Dose and Dose on Hand are identical before calculating (e.g., convert grams to milligrams if necessary).
Verify the calculation with a second licensed nurse, especially for high-alert medications like insulin, heparin, or pediatric doses.
Always check the provider's order, medication label, and patient allergies before administration.

disclaimer: This calculator is intended for nursing education and training purposes only. It should not replace clinical judgment, institutional protocols, or independent verification by a licensed healthcare professional.
